The session is born in `created` and is the container for everything agents do: the event log, proposed actions and the token budget all hang off it. `kind` is REQUIRED and gets recorded: `consultiva` (consultative) only converses, `criativa` (creative) produces and is the only one that accepts `execution.activated`.
